negative_findings.description: The e-Prokurimi document-management path https://e-prokurimi.rks-gov.net/SPIN_PROD/APPLICATION/IPN/DocumentManagement/DokumentiFrm.aspx returned an Albanian login form (Emri i shfrytëzuesit / Fjalëkalimi), not a public notice list.
negative_findings.result_summary: Login wall on the notice-list form path. This is a HYPOTHESIS about that specific path only — individual notice detail pages under the same tree (DokumentPodaciFrm.aspx?id=) are search-engine indexed and appear publicly readable, and the platform documentation refers to a public 'Lista e Njoftimeve' view whose exact public URL I did not confirm.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The collector must not assume a scrapeable HTML notice list on the portal. The OCDS API (ocdskrpp.rks-gov.net/krppAPI) should be the primary channel, with portal document fetches keyed by id resolved from the API.

negative_findings.description: No Serbian-language Kosovo-institution procurement search interface was located; sr-language queries returned Kosovo secondary legislation in Serbian on e-prokurimi.rks-gov.net plus Republic-of-Serbia sources (kim.gov.rs, paragraf.rs) that are jurisdictionally different.
negative_findings.result_summary: Serbian terminology for Kosovo notices is confirmed and usable ('javne nabavke', 'obaveštenje o dodeli ugovora', 'ugovor o uslugama'), and the platform does publish sr-language legislation, but I found no separate sr-language notice portal — the sr content lives inside the same platform.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Serbian-language collection should be implemented as a language parameter/keyword set against the same national platform, not as a separate source. Serbia-hosted 'Kosovo' procurement pages must be excluded to avoid jurisdictional contamination.

negative_findings.description: No specific Kosovo public-sector award notice for ATM, POS, card-issuance or core-banking lots was surfaced by open web search in either sq or en within this scouting pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Topical searches returned only foreign tenders (Ethiopia) and commercial aggregator landing pages. The only concrete Kosovo banking-adjacent notice found was a BQK life-insurance service award, which is not in scope.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Absence of search-engine visibility is not absence of notices — these lots are almost certainly present inside the platform but invisible to general web search because notice bodies are behind the application. Confirms that keyword search must be run against the OCDS API fields (tendername, Award), not against Google.

negative_findings.description: The KRPP OCDS API endpoints were read from the auto-generated ASP.NET Help page, which states 'No documentation available' for every method; response formats, DataFormat values, pagination behaviour, rate limits and whether CPV codes are exposed are all undocumented.
negative_findings.result_summary: Endpoint list is reliable; endpoint semantics are not. No authentication is mentioned, which suggests open access but does not prove it.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: An implementation pass must empirically probe Award and TenderRelease before the collector design is fixed; in particular whether banking/payments lots can be filtered by CPV or only by free-text tendername determines the whole keyword strategy.

negative_findings.description: The OCP Data Registry entry for Kosovo PPRC explicitly documents quality problems in the published OCDS: null values and field-name typos across a corpus of 75,710 tenders / 211,313 parties.
negative_findings.result_summary: Known-defective official open data, still the best available machine channel.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any supplier-concentration or value analysis built on this feed needs defensive parsing and a field-name normalisation layer, or banking/payments lots will be silently dropped.

negative_findings.description: No published BQK tender or award notice specifically for the ATS/RTGS/ACH interbank payment system was located, in sq, sr or en, despite targeted searches. Only descriptive pages about the system's 2016 go-live were found.
negative_findings.result_summary: Four query formulations across three languages returned payment-system descriptions, SWIFT directories and commercial aggregators, but zero procurement documents naming RTGS/ACH.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell rationale assumes BQK tenders payment infrastructure visibly. If those procurements are conducted under BQK's own rulebook, restricted procedures, or vendor-direct renewal, the tender record will never surface them and the pipeline must rely on financial statements, audit reports and vendor-side announcements instead.

negative_findings.description: Every automated fetch of bqk-kos.org returned HTTP 403 Forbidden — the tenders listing page and two PDFs (procurement rulebook, financial statements).
negative_findings.result_summary: 3/3 fetch attempts on bqk-kos.org returned 403 while the same URLs appear live and indexed in search results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single most important buyer in this cell is not collectible with plain HTTP fetching. Collection must use a browser-based agent with realistic headers; and the source must NOT be recorded as dead.

negative_findings.description: No National Audit Office (ZKA/NAO) audit report specifically of BQK — and specifically of BQK procurement — was identified. BQK's financial statements appear to be audited by an external private auditor rather than covered in the NAO's budget-organisation audit programme.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two sq-language searches surfaced NAO's general annual audit report and BQK's own financial statements, but no NAO report on BQK.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If BQK falls outside the NAO's audit universe, the 'audit report reveals the contract' mechanism in this cell's rationale does not apply to BQK itself — only to other regulators and ministries buying financial/IT services.

negative_findings.description: Both major civil-society mirrors show stale last-update dates: oshp.dplus.org last updated 16 Jan 2024, prokurimihapur.org last updated 27 Apr 2023.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both sites self-report update dates well over a year old as of Aug 2026.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These are the best-structured views of the appeal and contract record. If they are no longer maintained, structured access must be rebuilt directly against oshp.rks-gov.net and e-prokurimi.rks-gov.net, which are far harder to parse.

negative_findings.description: KRPP announced the launch of a new website; legacy ASP.NET URLs of the form krpp.rks-gov.net/Default.aspx?LID=1&PID=Legislation may redirect or break.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search returned both legacy Default.aspx URLs and a new-look krpp.rks-gov.net root, plus a KRPP notice about 'funksionalizimin e webfaqes së re'.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any collector pinned to legacy KRPP URL patterns will silently break; a 404 here means moved, not dead.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language (sr) coverage of this cell is materially thinner than Albanian. The only sr-language primary artefacts found were translated legal instruments (BQK procurement rules, KRPP instruction 002/2024, Law 2003/17) on the sq-primary domains — no sr-language notice board, sr-language OSHP decision search, or sr-language audit report was found.
negative_findings.result_summary: One dedicated sr query returned mostly translated legislation plus irrelevant regional central banks.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Serbian-language collection for XK procurement should be scoped to the /srb/ or ?lang=sr document trees of the same official domains rather than treated as a separate source population; expecting a parallel sr ecosystem would waste crawl budget.

negative_findings.description: Targeted sq/mixed query for recent news on ATM and POS terminal supply contracts in Kosovo ('POS terminale' OR 'bankomatë' Kosovë kompani furnizim lajm 2025) returned only bank product/marketing pages and regional Serbian bank POS pages — no news articles naming a supplier or a contract.
negative_findings.result_summary: Zero media hits; results dominated by raiffeisen-kosovo.com, nlb-kos.com, teb-kos.com product pages and Serbian banks' POS pages.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell premise inversely: supplier-side terminal contracts in Kosovo are largely invisible to general web search and will need site-scoped searching within each sq outlet plus bank corporate-news pages, not open-web queries.

negative_findings.description: The seed query 'nënshkruhet kontrata bankë Kosovë sistem pagesash' returned regulatory PDFs from BQK rather than any media report of a contract signing.
negative_findings.result_summary: All top results were BQK regulations on interbank payments and electronic payment instruments; no news item.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The phrase 'sistem pagesash' is regulator-owned vocabulary and pulls legal texts. Media-facing queries need contract-ceremony vocabulary instead (nënshkruhet marrëveshja, memorandum bashkëpunimi, partneritet, lansohet) plus an outlet-scoped site: filter.

negative_findings.description: Preportr (COHU investigative journalism centre) did not appear in any result set this run despite being queried by name alongside Kallxo.
negative_findings.result_summary: Recorded as a candidate at reduced confidence with no example URLs; its domain is asserted from prior knowledge, not from an observed link.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A named, on-topic procurement watchdog is missing from the evidence base; if the domain has moved, the highest-value long-form procurement source for Kosovo would be silently absent from the collection plan.

negative_findings.description: No RSS/Atom feed endpoints were confirmed for any of the sq outlets in this cell; no feed URL was observed in search results and no page was fetched to check for feed autodiscovery.
negative_findings.result_summary: Collection methods above therefore assume HTML listing-page polling.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Feed availability materially changes collection cost and latency for a weak-signal channel that depends on being early. This needs a per-domain probe pass before the collector is built.

negative_findings.description: No specific Serbian-language tender or award notice for BANKING or PAYMENT services by a Serb-majority Kosovo municipality (Severna Mitrovica, Zvecan, Zubin Potok, Leposavic, Gracanica, Strpce, Klokot, Ranilug, Partes, Novo Brdo) was surfaced by general web search, despite multiple sr-language query formulations.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search engines surfaced the portals and the notice-form templates but not individual banking/payment award records; such notices appear to live inside portal search interfaces and PDF attachments that general indexes do not reach.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that this cell cannot be covered by web search alone - collection must go through portal-internal search (e-prokurimi, prokurimihapur) rather than crawling the open web.

negative_findings.description: Several candidate URLs were identified only from search-result metadata and were not fetched in this pass (kosovo-online.com canonical domain, ekosova.rks-gov.net, Gracanica Online's own domain, EPS Elektrokosmet's dedicated procurement page).
negative_findings.result_summary: URLs are provided with reduced confidence_score; no liveness claim is made.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic verification pass must resolve these before they enter the monitoring list; a 403/timeout on any of them should be treated as bot-defence, not death.

negative_findings.description: No established Serbian-language term set was found in this pass for modern payment-acceptance concepts as used in Kosovo procurement (e.g. POS terminals, card acquiring, instant payments). Serbian sources use Serbia-standard terms (POS terminali, prihvatanje kartica, instant placanja) whose actual usage in Kosovo Serbian-language tender text is unconfirmed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Glossary built confidently for procurement mechanics (ugovorni organ, obavestenje o dodeli ugovora, ekonomski operater, tenderska dokumentacija) but not for payment-technology nouns.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Keyword filters built on Serbia-standard payments vocabulary may miss or over-match Kosovo Serbian-language notices, which are often translations from Albanian and use calqued wording.

negative_findings.description: It was not established whether the Serb-majority municipalities that operate parallel Serbia-recognised administrations publish procurement anywhere other than the Kosovo portal and their rks-gov.net sites - i.e. whether a parallel municipal procurement publication channel exists at all.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only Serbia-side central bodies (Kancelarija za KiM, EPS) were confirmed as parallel-structure buyers publishing on Serbian national channels; no parallel municipal-level publication venue was found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If parallel municipal spending is published nowhere, that spending is structurally invisible and must be inferred indirectly (media, Serbian budget line items, audit reports) rather than collected.

negative_findings.description: Direct fetch of the Kosovo Banking Association site (https://www.bankassoc-kos.com/Al/rreth-nesh/) returned HTTP 403 Forbidden.
negative_findings.result_summary: Treated as bot-defended-but-live hypothesis, not dead. Member names were partially recovered indirectly via a member bank's page (bkt-ks.com) and the association's Facebook page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The KBA member list is a primary pointer for the cell; a headless-browser collection path must be provisioned rather than assuming the source is unavailable.

negative_findings.description: Oda Ekonomike e Kosovës (OEK) does not expose a complete, browsable member directory in search-visible pages; only statute, departments and news were reachable.
negative_findings.result_summary: No 'lista e anëtarëve' page located for OEK despite Albanian-language querying.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The statutory chamber would be the broadest supplier enumeration; without a directory, actor discovery must lean on STIKK, AmCham and OEGJK plus ARBK activity-code queries.

negative_findings.description: Albanian-language searching for a debarred/excluded economic operators register ('lista e operatorëve ekonomikë të përjashtuar') returned Republic of Albania results (app.gov.al) rather than Kosovo.
negative_findings.result_summary: No Kosovo (KRPP) debarment/economic-operator register URL confirmed in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Shared Albanian terminology causes systematic Albania/Kosovo confusion; all sq queries for this run must be pinned with 'Kosovë', 'KRPP', 'rks-gov.net' to avoid contaminating the source list.

negative_findings.description: The 'Lista e Autoriteteve Kontraktuese' is referenced as a section of the e-Prokurimi portal but no stable deep URL to the list itself was observed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only the portal root (e-prokurimi.rks-gov.net/Home/) and the annual-report PDFs were observed; the list URL is unconfirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must include a navigation step or a browser session against the portal rather than a fixed deep link.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language (sr) searching surfaced only one Kosovo-specific chamber (Privredna komora Kosova i Metohije) and otherwise returned Serbia-proper institutions (APR, PKS regional chambers).
negative_findings.result_summary: No sr-language enumeration of Kosovo-licensed banks, payment firms or IT suppliers was found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Serb-majority-municipality actors and any sr-language procurement notices risk being under-covered; sr coverage of this cell is currently weak and should not be presented as complete.

negative_findings.description: Searched specifically for a Kosovo beneficial-ownership register ('regjistri i pronarëve përfitues'); no dedicated public BO register URL was identified.
negative_findings.result_summary: Ownership data appears reachable only via ARBK company records and third-party mirrors (ARBK Open, OpenCorporates, OCCRP Aleph).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Ownership tracing behind tender awards will depend on registry extracts and aggregators, with the reliability caveats those carry.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Kosovo-hosted fintech/payments conference with a published agenda and sponsor list was found for Pristina in 2026; the only clearly Kosovo-relevant payments event surfaced is the regional Balkan Payment Forum (organiser based outside Kosovo) plus BQK-hosted regulator conferences.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in sq and en returned generic global fintech-event calendars (Money20/20, eventbrowse, tapix, vendelux) rather than a Kosovo-specific payments expo.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's event-signal channel for Kosovo depends mainly on regulator-hosted conferences and regional events; there is no local trade expo whose exhibitor list can be harvested annually.

negative_findings.description: No specific LinkedIn or press announcement of a Kosovo bank or PSP naming a core-banking/payments implementation partner was located through open web search in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Query returned generic vendor marketing (Skaleet, PSP Lab, sdk.finance) and one relevant institutional item (IFC/SECO partnership with BQK on digital financial services).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Vendor-announcement signals for Kosovo appear to live behind LinkedIn's login wall rather than on the open web, so this channel likely needs licensed access or manual analyst review.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language hiring/event signals specific to Kosovo banks are very thin: sr searches surfaced only generic Serbian job boards filtered to Kosovska Mitrovica, with no bank-specific 'konkurs' for a Kosovo-licensed bank found.
negative_findings.result_summary: sr query 'konkurs za posao banka Kosovo Mitrovica' returned board homepages, not bank adverts.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: sr is a mandated language for this run; the coverage exists only as a thin, low-yield channel and should not be assumed equivalent to the sq channel.

negative_findings.description: None of the URLs in this slice were fetched for liveness during this pass; all are recorded from search-result metadata and search-snippet content.
negative_findings.result_summary: Discovery-only pass; no fetch verdicts issued.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream deterministic verification must confirm reachability; absence of a fetch here is not evidence a source is dead.

negative_findings.description: Attempted to query the Internet Archive Wayback CDX API for the historical capture inventory of e-prokurimi.rks-gov.net, which is the canonical way to recover tender pages deleted from the live portal.
negative_findings.result_summary: The fetch tool returned 'Claude Code is unable to fetch from web.archive.org' — an environment-level restriction, not evidence that the Wayback Machine lacks Kosovo procurement captures. No conclusion can be drawn about actual archive coverage from this session.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Web archives are named explicitly in this coverage cell and are the primary recovery route for removed tender pages. This capability gap must be closed by another means before the archival layer can be considered covered.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Albanian for a central, queryable register of expired or archived contract notices on e-prokurimi itself (arkivi i njoftimeve të skaduara).
negative_findings.result_summary: No dedicated public 'expired notices archive' interface was found on e-prokurimi.rks-gov.net. Historical notices appear to be reachable only through the OCDS API by date range, or via copies held on municipal and institutional websites. The portal's own front end appears to surface current activity.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the premise of this cell: the archival layer must be reconstructed from the API plus third-party mirrors rather than read off a native archive view. It also means the OCDS date-range sweep is not optional — it is the only systematic route.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Albanian for a published register or archive of framework agreements specifically covering banking and payments equipment (ATMs, POS terminals, card personalisation, cash handling) for Kosovo public buyers.
negative_findings.result_summary: No sector-specific framework-agreement register was found. AQP's centralized contract listing is the correct register but the examples visible in search results were generic supply categories (paper, office materials, food, vehicles, fuel). Banking/payments framework contracts, if they exist, are not separately indexed and must be extracted by CPV/subject filtering over the full corpus.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets realistic expectations for the collection design: sector targeting has to happen at the parse stage over a full-corpus sweep, not by finding a ready-made vertical register.

negative_findings.description: Searched for a procurement notice or contract archive on the Central Bank of Kosovo (BQK) website, which as a payments-sector buyer and regulator would be a priority contracting authority.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only BQK annual institutional/financial reports surfaced (bqk-kos.org, including a wp-content/uploads PDF tree). No procurement-specific notice archive or contract register was located for BQK in this pass. This is unverified absence, not confirmed absence — the site was not crawled directly.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: BQK is among the most relevant single buyers for this run's sector focus. If it has no published procurement archive, its awards must be recovered from the central KRPP OCDS feed by partyName, and the BQK annual report becomes the fallback source for capital-expenditure signals.

negative_findings.description: Attempted to read the KRPP institutional homepage (krpp.rks-gov.net) to enumerate its navigation, annual-report index and archive sections.
negative_findings.result_summary: The fetch returned only the page title 'KOMISIONI RREGULLATIV I PROKURIMIT PUBLIK' with no navigation or links, consistent with a JavaScript-rendered single-page front end. This is a rendering limitation and a hypothesis of client-side rendering, not evidence the site is dead — the sibling e-prokurimi document paths resolve normally.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The report and archive index on krpp.rks-gov.net may only be reachable via a headless browser or an underlying JSON endpoint. Until then, annual reports must be addressed by direct document-path enumeration on e-prokurimi.rks-gov.net rather than by following site navigation.

negative_findings.description: Fetched the PPRC 2022 English annual report PDF to confirm liveness and inspect its statistical tables.
negative_findings.result_summary: A 2.2 MB application/pdf payload was returned, so the /eng/ document path is populated, but the fetch tool could not extract text from the binary and the statistical table inventory could not be confirmed in this pass. Treat the URL as promising-but-unparsed; liveness verification remains the job of the separate deterministic pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The annual-report series is the backbone of the statistical layer for this cell. Collection tooling must include a real PDF text/table extractor, since a plain fetch-to-markdown step will silently fail on this entire source family.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language (sr) searching for a Kosovo procurement archive returned markedly thinner results than Albanian, and several hits were for the separate Serbian and Montenegrin national procurement systems rather than Kosovo.
negative_findings.result_summary: Serbian terms did work — Regulatorna komisija za javne nabavke (RKJN), javne nabavke, ugovori, godišnji izveštaj, arhiva — and yielded the D+ institutional analysis, the ZKA Serbian publications path (/sr/), and the legacy Assembly legislative archive in Serbian. But no Serbian-language archive of Kosovo tender notices or a Serbian edition of the PPRC annual report series was located.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Serbian-language procurement records matter for northern municipalities and Serb-majority contracting authorities. The apparent absence may reflect genuine non-publication in Serbian, or a search-reach limitation; either way the sr layer of this cell is not yet demonstrably covered.

negative_findings.description: Looked for a bulk export, API, or open-data download from the civil-society prokurimihapur.org portal, which holds pre-2016 contract data unavailable elsewhere.
negative_findings.result_summary: The about page documents a web UI (Contracts, Buyers, Suppliers, Network, Report) and states data are freely accessible in readable format, but names no API and no bulk download. Programmatic access would require HTML scraping or a direct request to Lëvizja FOL.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 2010–2016 window is only practically covered by this portal, so the absence of bulk export is the main friction point for extending the historical baseline behind the OCDS start date.

negative_findings.description: Direct fetch of https://kk.rks-gov.net/prishtine/prokurimi/njoftim-per-kontrate/ failed with getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND kk.rks-gov.net from this environment.
negative_findings.result_summary: DNS did not resolve. This is a HYPOTHESIS of an egress/geo/DNS restriction on this host, NOT evidence the site is dead — the domain appears as a live indexed result under at least two different municipality slugs (prishtine, skenderaj). Must be re-attempted by the deterministic verification pass, ideally from a European egress.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: kk.rks-gov.net is the backbone of this entire cell (~38 municipalities). If it stays unreachable from the collection host, municipal-level banking tenders — the single densest and lowest-visibility segment — are lost.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language search for Kosovo municipal banking-services tenders (opština / javne nabavke / bankarske usluge / platni promet / obaveštenje o ugovoru) returned almost entirely Serbia, Montenegro and Bosnia sources, not Kosovo authorities.
negative_findings.result_summary: The only Kosovo-specific sr-language hit was the official Serbian translation of the public procurement instruction on e-prokurimi.rks-gov.net. No Serbian-language procurement page of a Kosovo municipality (e.g. the four northern municipalities) was located in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Kosovo law provides for Serbian as an official language and Serb-majority municipalities are genuine contracting authorities with their own banking arrangements. Failing to reach them leaves a language-and-territory hole, and sr-language queries also risk polluting the corpus with Serbia-proper tenders that must be filtered out.

negative_findings.description: No authority-hosted notice explicitly for bank current-account / salary-payment / e-payment-gateway services was retrieved during this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language terms were used ('shërbime bankare', 'llogari rrjedhëse', 'pagesa elektronike', 'arkëtim', 'bankarske usluge', 'platni promet') but search surfaced the procurement PAGES rather than any matching individual notice. The observed authority-hosted notices were for other categories (insurance, lab equipment, uniforms, books, oils).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell's core thesis needs document-level crawling, not search-engine discovery: these notices exist as PDFs inside listing pages that search engines index poorly. Budget for full-text PDF harvesting rather than query-based discovery.

negative_findings.description: No own-site procurement page located for several important buyers: KEK (kek-energy.com), Trepça Sh.A., regional water utilities (Ujësjellësi Rajonal), and SHSKUK / individual hospitals.
negative_findings.result_summary: These authorities were confirmed to exist and to procure, but only via the central portal, media reporting, or aggregators. Their own procurement URLs were not identified in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: POEs and hospitals are large-payroll, high-cash-handling buyers. If they publish only centrally, the cell's added value for them is zero and coverage should be delegated to the central-portal cell instead of duplicated here.

negative_findings.description: UN Development Business (devbusiness.un.org), historically the mandated publication channel for World Bank and MCC General Procurement Notices, is reported to have phased down operations and ceased website activity on 31 March 2025.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search results state UNDB ceased activity; legacy notice URLs such as https://devbusiness.un.org/notices/cdb-p836201 may persist as archive only. Not independently fetch-verified in this pass — treat as unverified hypothesis, not a confirmed death.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any collection design that anchors on UNDB for donor GPNs will silently return nothing post-2025; the pipeline must be rebuilt on projects.worldbank.org, ECEPP, dgMarket and implementing-entity sites, and historical UNDB pages should be pulled from web archives while they last.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated procurement or tender page was found for the Deposit Insurance Fund of Kosovo (Fondi i Sigurimit të Depozitave në Kosovë) or the Kosovo Credit Guarantee Fund (Fondi Kosovar për Garanci Kreditore), despite both being named implementing agencies of the World Bank Financial Sector Development Project.
negative_findings.result_summary: Albanian-language search on 'prokurim', 'tender', 'ftesë për ofertë' plus both institution names returned institutional/Facebook/LinkedIn pages and enabling legislation, but no procurement board on fondikgk.org or an FSDK site.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Two of the three FSDP implementing agencies may publish their notices only inside World Bank channels or on social media, meaning a site-level watcher would miss them. Collection should lean on the WB notice portal and on the institutions' Facebook/LinkedIn feeds as a fallback.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language searching for donor-funded financial-sector tenders in Kosovo returned almost no Kosovo-specific procurement surface.
negative_findings.result_summary: Query 'Kosovo tender javni poziv nabavka finansijski sektor projekat finansiran od EU' returned mostly Serbia-focused portals (euzatebe.rs, evropa.gov.rs, tenderteam.rs) plus one generic aggregator page for Kosovo and EEAS Serbian-language press releases.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Donor procurement notices for Kosovo appear to be published in Albanian and English, with Serbian used mainly for political/communications output rather than tender documents. Serbian-language monitoring should target EEAS _sr press releases and Serbian-language Kosovo media rather than tender boards, and Serbian coverage should not be treated as a parity requirement for this cell.

negative_findings.description: Commercial tender aggregators (tendersinfo.com, tendersontime.com, globaltenders.com, biddetail.com, javne-nabavke.com, developmentaid.org) dominate search results for almost every donor+Kosovo query.
negative_findings.result_summary: These sites rank highly, present recycled or SEO-generated 'Kosovo Tenders 2026' pages, and gate actual notice content behind subscriptions; several appear to restate notices without a verifiable primary link.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: They are a credibility and cost trap: high recall, low verifiability, restrictive ToS. They should be excluded from automated collection and used at most for lead generation with mandatory resolution back to the issuing donor's own notice.

negative_findings.description: EBRD, EIB and IFC financial-intermediary operations in Kosovo (credit lines to commercial banks, guarantees, equity, advisory) generate no public procurement notice at all.
negative_findings.result_summary: The Kosovo EBRD financial-sector activity found in this pass (e.g. up to EUR 5m to a Kosovo bank under Go Digital in the Western Balkans with EU-funded incentives) surfaced only as a press release, not as any tender.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A procurement-notice-only collection strategy will systematically under-count private-sector donor money flowing into Kosovo bank digitalisation. Project Summary Documents, press releases and disclosure registers must be collected alongside tender feeds to see this spend.

negative_findings.description: Albanian-language searching for EU Office in Kosovo financial-sector tender calls ('Zyra e BE-së në Kosovë thirrje për tender sektori financiar') returned no dedicated sq-language tender listing page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Results surfaced the delegation's institutional sq pages (kush-jemi-ne_sq, bashkimi-evropian-dhe-kosova_sq) and a job board, not tender notices. EU-channel tender notices for Kosovo appear to be published predominantly in English, with only institutional/communication content localised into sq.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell's premise: for EU-level procurement the working language is English, so sq/sr querying is useful mainly for actor names and glossary, not for finding the notices themselves. Collection design should not depend on sq-language tender feeds.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language search for EU Office in Kosovo procurement ('Kancelarija Evropske unije na Kosovu javne nabavke tenderi poziv') found no official sr-language EU tender feed for Kosovo.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only third-party sr aggregators (javne-nabavke.com, nabavke.com) republishing EEAS notices, plus the delegation's sr 'ko smo mi' page naming the Finance and Contracts Section (Odsek za finansije i ugovore, delegation-kosovo-fincon@eeas.europa.eu).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: sr-language coverage of this cell must be obtained via commercial aggregators or by translating English notices; there is no primary sr channel to monitor.

negative_findings.description: No Kosovo central-bank / banking-supervision Twinning fiche was located in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search surfaced Kosovo twinning fiches in other sectors (personal data protection, public finance, media) and a regional 'Strengthening Central Bank Capacities in the Western Balkans' programme naming CBK/BQK as beneficiary, but no Kosovo-specific banking-supervision twinning fiche document.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Either such a fiche does not exist (Kosovo central-bank support may run through regional ESCB programmes and IMF/WB rather than twinning) or it is buried in non-indexed PDFs. Needs a dedicated deeper pass before concluding.

negative_findings.description: FTS coverage of IPA Kosovo contracts is structurally incomplete.
negative_findings.result_summary: EC guidance encountered in results states that for IPA one should consult national IPA coordinators rather than the Financial Transparency System, because a share of IPA is not under direct management.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any vendor-level analysis built on FTS alone will systematically under-count Kosovo IPA contracts; must be complemented with TED award notices and DG ENEST/IATI beneficiary data.

negative_findings.description: No source in this slice was fetched or liveness-tested; all URLs are search-derived.
negative_findings.result_summary: This pass used web search only. Some URLs (notably the wbif.eu root, the EIB TA calls index, the DG ENEST twinning landing page and the EEAS Kosovo delegation root) are constructed from known site structure rather than observed in a result snippet, and are flagged with lower confidence.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic verification pass must resolve these; a 403/404 on any of them should be treated as a hypothesis to re-check, not proof the source is dead.

negative_findings.description: ProCredit Bank Kosova (procreditbank-kos.com) has no discoverable tender, RFP or supplier-registration page. Site-scoped searches in Albanian ('ftesë për ofertë', 'shpallje', 'furnizim', 'tender') returned only product, pricing and news pages, while sibling ProCredit entities in Serbia, Georgia, Ukraine and Albania all expose /tenders paths.
negative_findings.result_summary: Kosovo entity appears to run procurement privately or via the holding, publishing nothing locally; a direct fetch of its business-ethics page also returned HTTP 500 (unverified, not dead).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: ProCredit is a systemic Kosovo bank; if its RFPs are invisible, its IT/card/self-service buying can only be inferred from vendor announcements, group signals or interviews, leaving a real blind spot in A2 coverage.

negative_findings.description: Ziraat Bank Kosova SHA exposes no tender, procurement or supplier page; only a general 'Lajmërime/announcements' feed. Turkish-parent procurement terminology ('ihale') was not tested against the Kosovo domain because the site publishes only sq/en.
negative_findings.result_summary: No procurement surface located for Ziraat Kosovo.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A locally incorporated Turkish-parent bank undergoing legal transformation is likely to be buying systems now, invisibly.

negative_findings.description: No open group-level supplier-registration or e-sourcing portal was found for RBI (rbinternational.com resolves to a platform login), for NLB Group (no 'javna naročila'/'dobavitelji' portal on nlb.si or nlbgroup.com), or for ProCredit Holding. Searched in de/sl/sr/en.
negative_findings.result_summary: Foreign parents do not run public vendor portals reachable without authentication; RBI's supplier code even prohibits suppliers disclosing anything about pending group procurements.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell rationale assumed group procurement portals would be a route into Kosovo subsidiary buying; they are not. Collection must lean on local bank pages, vendor-side announcements and human sourcing.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language queries ('javne nabavke', 'dobavljači', 'tender ponuda') for Kosovo commercial banks returned Serbia-based portals (nbs.rs, nabavke.com, javne-nabavke.com, tenderbiro.rs) and no Kosovo bank content; the sole Kosovo hit was the Albanian NLB notice page.
negative_findings.result_summary: Kosovo commercial banks appear not to publish procurement notices in Serbian, even though it is an official language.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Serbian-language monitoring for this cell should be reweighted toward North Kosovo / Serbia-facing media and vendor sources rather than bank tender pages; it is not a productive channel for bank RFPs.

negative_findings.description: None of the Kosovo bank tender pages examined (NLB, TEB, BKT, Banka Ekonomike, BPB, Raiffeisen) published award results, winning bidder names or contract values — only invitations, specifications and deadline extensions.
negative_findings.result_summary: Award-notice coverage for private bank procurement in Kosovo is effectively zero.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The 'award notices' topic in this run cannot be satisfied from private-buyer sources; outcomes must be reconstructed from vendor press releases, reference lists, LinkedIn and observed deployments.

negative_findings.description: bkt-ks.com returned a TLS chain error ('unable to verify the first certificate') on direct fetch, while its tender URLs are fully present in the search index.
negative_findings.result_summary: Treated as bot/TLS-configuration friction, not as a dead source.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A naive collector would wrongly mark one of the richest tender feeds in the cell as unreachable.

negative_findings.description: No public tender portal, notice board or RFP feed operated by any Kosovo licensed payment institution, e-money institution or remittance firm was found. Searched in sq ('tender', 'njoftim për kontratë', 'furnizim me terminale POS') and en against company sites (UFP, Moneta, OneFor, Swinto, IBAS, Paysera Kosova).
negative_findings.result_summary: Private payment-sector procurement in Kosovo appears to be entirely unpublished; only corporate news, partner press and job ads reveal it.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Coverage of this cell cannot rely on tender feeds — it must be built from the licence register plus company/partner/vendor announcement monitoring, which changes the collection design and expected latency.

negative_findings.description: No independent third-party card switch, processor or ATM/POS network operator serving Kosovo was identified. Searches in en and sq repeatedly returned only BQK (operator of the sole payment system, the Interbank Payment System) and individual banks' own acquiring.
negative_findings.result_summary: Switching/processing appears to be bank-internal or outsourced abroad rather than run by a domestic non-bank processor.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If confirmed, the 'processor' segment of this cell is empty domestically and terminal/switching demand sits with banks and with foreign processors — a materially different buyer map than assumed in the cell definition.

negative_findings.description: Two bqk-kos.org URLs (the licensed-institutions list PDF and the non-bank financial institutions section page) returned HTTP 403 on fetch, although both are indexed and linked from search results.
negative_findings.result_summary: Hypothesis: bot defence / user-agent filtering on the BQK web server, not removal.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single most important register in this cell needs a browser-grade fetcher; a naive crawler would wrongly record it as dead.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language (sr) searching produced no Kosovo-specific non-bank payments procurement sources. Cyrillic queries on Kosovo payment processing tenders returned only Serbia-domestic material (NBS tariffs, Serbian banks, KZK case files).
negative_findings.result_summary: sr coverage of this cell is effectively empty at the search-engine level; north-Kosovo payment arrangements were not surfaced by these queries.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The Serbian-language segment of Kosovo's payments landscape (Serbian-system institutions and cash/remittance channels in the north) may be systematically invisible to this method and needs a targeted approach.

negative_findings.description: Several fintechs surfaced (IBAS, Swinto, UPay) describe themselves as licensed e-money or payment platforms serving Kosovo, but their licensing jurisdiction was not confirmed against the BQK register within this run.
negative_findings.result_summary: Names captured as candidates with reduced credibility scores pending register cross-check.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Treating an EU-licensed firm as a BQK licensee would distort the buyer universe for this cell.

negative_findings.description: No Kosovo-specific contract-win press release was found on Asseco SEE's or Payten's newsrooms via search, despite both having a Kosovo presence (ASSECO SEE SH.P.K.) and heavy regional announcement activity.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned only Serbia/Croatia/North Macedonia bank announcements. Payten news listing fetched directly showed five recent items, none Kosovo-related.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Suggests Kosovo wins by the dominant regional vendor group are either not announced or announced only in local/LinkedIn channels — collection must include vendor LinkedIn feeds and local-language press, not only corporate newsrooms.

negative_findings.description: Albanian-language and Serbian-language searches for vendor-announced Kosovo bank contracts returned no supply-side announcements at all.
negative_findings.result_summary: sq query ('Kosovë bankë kontratë sistem bankar zbatim kompani IT zgjidhje softuerike') and sr query ('banka Kosovo bankarski softver ugovor implementacija integrator') both returned generic banking-sector material (BQK documents, Wikipedia, academic theses), not vendor press releases.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Local-language general web search is a weak channel for this cell; the productive local-language route is likely vendor/bank LinkedIn posts and local business media, which general search engines index poorly.

negative_findings.description: printec.eu is NOT the banking-technology Printec.
negative_findings.result_summary: Fetch of https://www.printec.eu/ returned a German-language decorative-lighting company (references_fashion, products_decorative_lights). The banking integrator is printecgroup.com, which returned HTTP 403 to a plain fetch.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a false-positive source and a wasted monitoring pipeline; also flags that printecgroup.com needs browser-like fetching.

negative_findings.description: No evidence found of a named Kosovo bank running Temenos, Oracle FLEXCUBE, BPC SmartVista or OpenWay Way4.
negative_findings.result_summary: Vendor-name + Kosovo searches surfaced only generic product-comparison pages and technographics teasers; no vendor case study or press release naming a Kosovo institution.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The core-banking/switch layer for Kosovo banks remains unattributed; this is the single biggest unknown in the supply-side picture and should drive targeted collection (RFP documents, bank annual reports, job ads naming systems).

negative_findings.description: printecgroup.com returned HTTP 403 on WebFetch.
negative_findings.result_summary: Single failed fetch; almost certainly bot defence rather than a dead site (the company is active and has a Kosovo entity registered per D&B).
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Must not be recorded as dead; requires a headless-browser or header-spoofing collector.

negative_findings.description: No aggregator or open-contracting dataset was found that is scoped specifically to banking, payments, cards, POS or ATM procurement in Kosovo.
negative_findings.result_summary: Every aggregator located is generalist (all-sector) and must be filtered by CPV code or keyword. Searching explicitly for banking/ATM/card tender aggregation for Kosovo returned only generic country pages and IFI portals.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must own the sector filtering layer (CPV + Albanian/Serbian keyword lists); no vendor supplies a ready-made banking-sector Kosovo feed.

negative_findings.description: Kosovo's OCDS publication has documented structural gaps and a stale quality review.
negative_findings.result_summary: The OCP registry entry reports ~211k parties and ~75.7k tenders but zero counts for awards, contracts and planning; the awards array is misspelled 'award'; procuringEntity sits in a non-standard location; Lots extension fields have typos; last quality review November 2021.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Award-notice coverage — the part that reveals who actually won banking/IT contracts — cannot be assumed present in the OCDS feed alone; a second source (Integrity Watch, Prokurimi i Hapur, or the portal itself) is required for awards.

negative_findings.description: Prokurimi i Hapur may not be refreshing.
negative_findings.result_summary: The site states data is currently being updated through the API system and asks users to report errors; the most recent update date observed on the page was 27 April 2023.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If the portal is frozen, it remains valuable as a historical archive but cannot serve as a live monitoring feed. Needs a liveness check before it is wired into a pipeline.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language aggregator coverage of Kosovo is thin and politically framed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Serbian-language searching surfaced only one aggregator with a real Kosovo section (javne-nabavke.com) plus a regional player (eKapija) whose stated coverage is BiH/Serbia/Montenegro. The Kosovo page's top-buyer list leads with a Serbia-administered provisional municipal body, indicating partial rather than national coverage.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Serbian-language collection cannot be relied on for full Kosovo coverage; sq and en remain the primary languages, with sr used mainly for Serb-majority municipality and cross-border angles.

negative_findings.description: dgMarket was referenced as a procurement aggregator but no Kosovo-specific dgMarket endpoint was located.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search results mentioned dgMarket only second-hand via a donor page; no dgMarket Kosovo country URL was reached in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: dgMarket historically aggregated World Bank/donor notices; if still active it would fill the IFI channel. Should be re-checked directly rather than recorded as absent.

negative_findings.description: Several commercial aggregators' Kosovo coverage depth could not be measured without a paid subscription.
negative_findings.result_summary: TendersInfo, GlobalTenders, TenderImpulse, TendersGo and TendersOnTime all advertise Kosovo coverage, but the actual notice count, latency and whether they carry award notices is behind a paywall/registration wall.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Their marketing claims must not be recorded as verified coverage; a trial-based bake-off against the OCDS feed is needed before any is paid for.

negative_findings.description: No Kosovo watchdog or investigative outlet was found publishing a dedicated investigation into procurement of BANKING or PAYMENT services specifically (e.g. state treasury banking services, card acquiring, POS/ATM supply, payment-system IT contracts).
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in sq, sr and en combining bank/payment terms with tender/procurement terms returned generic banking-sector coverage (bank complaints, bank stability) or generic procurement coverage, but no bank-services award investigation.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The watchdog ecosystem is strong on infrastructure, energy and vehicle contracts; banking/payments procurement appears to be an unwatched niche, so this cell will need keyword-level monitoring of raw award data rather than relying on ready-made investigations.

negative_findings.description: Transparency International has no standalone national chapter website for Kosovo; TI-related procurement monitoring surfaces through the Kosovo Democratic Institute (KDI) as national contact.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches for a 'Transparency International Kosovo' site returned KDI publications and TI regional/global index references instead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection should target kdi-kosova.org rather than looking for a TI-XK domain that likely does not exist.

negative_findings.description: Democracy Plus reports the official OSHP (Procurement Review Body) website has had problems since December 2025, with documents older than six months inaccessible.
negative_findings.result_summary: Reported by D+ and echoed in Kosovo media (Epoka e Re, Aug 2026) as part of a wider public-institution web transparency crisis.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Official appeal-decision provenance is unreliable; the CSO mirror at oshp.dplus.org becomes the de-facto archive of record and should be collected proactively before it too goes stale.

negative_findings.description: Two Serbian-language watchdog domains (newsocialinitiative.org, ngoaktiv.org) were inferred from organisation names in third-party coverage rather than confirmed by a direct fetch.
negative_findings.result_summary: Their procurement work is documented via Alternativna and Radio Mitrovica Sever coverage; own sites not opened during this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These are the only Serbian-language procurement-monitoring producers found; a wrong domain would silently drop sr-language coverage of the north.

negative_findings.description: No Kosovo-specific document-leak or whistleblower publishing platform (SecureDrop-style) dedicated to procurement documents was identified beyond KALLXO's general corruption-reporting intake.
negative_findings.result_summary: KALLXO functions as the citizen reporting intake; no separate leaked-contract repository surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Underlying contract PDFs will mostly have to come from e-Prokurimi/OPTP or from documents embedded in individual articles.

coverage_gaps.description: I did not establish whether Kosovo notices carry CPV codes and, if so, whether the OCDS feed exposes them. Without CPV, banking/payments lots must be identified by trilingual free-text matching, which is far noisier.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe krppAPI/Tender and krppAPI/Award for a CPV/classification field; if absent, build and tune a sq/sr/en keyword filter (shërbime bankare, kartela, bankomat/ATM, terminal POS, sistem bazë bankar, transport i parave/vlerave; bankarske usluge, kartice, bankomat, POS terminal) and measure precision against a hand-labelled sample.

coverage_gaps.description: Public enterprises (ndërmarrjet publike — KEK, Posta e Kosovës, Telekomi i Kosovës, regional water companies) are major buyers of cash-collection, POS and payment-acceptance services and may procure under utility rules or publish on their own sites; I did not map their individual procurement pages.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a per-enterprise buyer registry with each entity's procurement/notice page URL and cross-check against the platform's contracting-authority list.

coverage_gaps.description: The public 'Lista e Njoftimeve' (daily list of published notices) view referenced in e-Prokurimi user documentation was not located at a confirmed public URL.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Retrieve the e-Prokurimi user manual from the MANUALET section (ClanakItemNew.aspx?id=378) and extract the exact public notice-list path; verify with a browser session rather than a bare fetch.

coverage_gaps.description: Serbian-language coverage was exercised only at the terminology level (legislation and form names). I did not confirm whether individual notice bodies for banking lots are actually published in Serbian on the platform or only in Albanian.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Sample notices via the API and inspect the language of tendername/description fields; if Serbian bodies exist, add them to the keyword filter and record the language field per record.

coverage_gaps.description: Contract signature notices and contract-modification/annex notices were not separately confirmed as distinct, retrievable notice types in the feed — only contract notices and award notices were.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the KRPP standard form codes (B-series, e.g. B08) from the Rules and Operational Guideline PDF and map each to the OCDS release tags exposed by krppAPI, so signature and modification events are not lost.

coverage_gaps.description: Donor and IFI procurement inside Kosovo (EU Office/IPA, World Bank, EBRD, UNDP) for financial-sector and payment-infrastructure projects sits entirely outside the national platform; I sampled only IOM.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add the EU Office in Kosovo, UNDP Kosovo, World Bank and EBRD procurement notice feeds as a separate sub-cell, filtered to Kosovo country code.

coverage_gaps.description: It is not established whether BQK is subject to Law 04/L-042 on Public Procurement or procures autonomously under its own Executive-Board rulebook, and therefore whether its tenders appear on e-Prokurimi and whether its awards are appealable to OSHP.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Retrieve the BQK procurement rulebook (sq/sr/en variants) via a browser-capable fetcher and cross-read against Law 03/L-209 (BQK) and Law 04/L-042 (PPL) on gzk.rks-gov.net; then test empirically by querying the OSHP search for contracting authority = BQK.

coverage_gaps.description: AQP (Central Procurement Agency) was identified but its site structure, notice format and framework-contract listings were not inspected in this run.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Crawl aqp.rks-gov.net and catalogue whether framework contracts for banking services, cards and IT/software are listed with supplier names and values.

coverage_gaps.description: Other financial-sector regulators/supervisors as buyers were not covered: the Kosovo Deposit Insurance Fund (FSDK), the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU-K), the Kosovo Pension Savings Trust (Trusti/KPST), the Tax Administration (ATK) and Customs — all of which buy payment, card, collection and core-financial IT systems.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the actor map to FSDK, NJIF-K/FIU (fiu.rks-gov.net), Trusti/KPST, ATK (pak-ks.org — already observed publishing an 'OBAVEŠTENJE O DODELI UGOVORA') and Dogana, and scout each one's procurement page in a follow-up cell.

coverage_gaps.description: No confirmed, documented API or bulk-download endpoint exists for Kosovo procurement notices or OSHP decisions. prokurimihapur.org references an API but does not document it; e-Prokurimi and OSHP expose only HTML search.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe the network calls behind the prokurimihapur.org and OSHP search UIs for JSON endpoints; if none, budget for HTML scraping plus PDF parsing, and consider a formal access-to-public-documents request to KRPP for bulk notice data.

coverage_gaps.description: Historical depth of OSHP decisions on the official site is unverified — it is unclear how far back oshp.rks-gov.net's searchable corpus reaches versus the D+ mirror.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a bounded date-range query on the official OSHP search to find the earliest available decision, and compare counts against oshp.dplus.org for overlapping years to measure completeness.

coverage_gaps.description: Vendor-side disclosure (payment-system suppliers announcing Kosovo central-bank wins in press releases, case studies or IFI-funded project documents) was not scouted, though it is often the only public trace of a central-bank infrastructure contract.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a follow-up cell covering vendor press rooms, World Bank/EBRD/EU-IPA project procurement notices and IFI contract-award databases for Kosovo financial-infrastructure projects.

coverage_gaps.description: This cell is scoped to Albanian-language media only. Serbian-language Kosovo outlets (northern-municipality and Serb-community media) were deliberately not searched, so any bank/payments signal that appears only in sr within Kosovo is uncovered by this slice.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assign a companion cell for sr-language Kosovo media (e.g. KoSSev, Kontakt Plus, Radio Gorazdevac and Belgrade outlets covering Kosovo) using sr terms: potpisan ugovor, tender, bankomat, POS terminali, platni sistem.

coverage_gaps.description: Trade/vendor-side media were not covered: regional IT and fintech trade press, vendor press-release wires, and LinkedIn/company newsrooms of payments suppliers active in Kosovo. These often announce a win before any Kosovo outlet reports it.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a cell for vendor and regional trade press plus supplier newsroom monitoring (card personalisation, ATM/POS vendors, core-banking integrators operating in the Western Balkans).

coverage_gaps.description: No archival or historical-search capability was established for these sq outlets. Kosovo news portals restructure and quietly unpublish; several older links surfaced in this run were from paths that may not persist.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair each monitored outlet with a Wayback Machine snapshot check and archive every captured item's URL at collection time.

coverage_gaps.description: Municipal-level sq media (Prizren, Gjakovë, Ferizaj, Mitrovicë local portals and radio) were not enumerated. Municipal contracting authorities are a large share of Kosovo procurement volume and their awards are often reported only locally.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Harvest the local-outlet link list from the sq aggregator (shkabaj.net) and triage municipal portals for a follow-on cell.

coverage_gaps.description: All searching this run was open-web. No site-scoped searching (site:telegrafi.com kontratë bankë, site:kallxo.com bankomat) was performed, which is the technique most likely to actually surface the low-frequency contract items this cell targets.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-run this cell with per-domain site: queries against the ~10 confirmed sq outlets using the full sq glossary, and look past the first page of results.

coverage_gaps.description: Only Severna Mitrovica's own municipal site was confirmed at URL level; the individual official sites of Zvecan, Zubin Potok, Leposavic, Gracanica, Strpce, Klokot, Ranilug, Partes and Novo Brdo were not individually resolved in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Harvest the full municipality URL list from mapl.rks-gov.net/sr/portal-opstina/ and register each municipality's /sr/ procurement section as a separate source.

coverage_gaps.description: No Serbian-language audit source was covered: Kosovo's National Audit Office (ZKA/NKR) municipal audit reports and Serbia's DRI (Drzavna revizorska institucija) reports on Kancelarija za KiM both examine contracting and banking arrangements retrospectively.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add zka-rks.org (Serbian-language municipal audit reports) and dri.rs (reports covering KiM-funded bodies) as direct sources in a follow-up pass.

coverage_gaps.description: The supply side is uncovered: Serbian-language corporate registries and bank/vendor announcements (banks operating or formerly operating in Serb-majority areas - Komercijalna/NLB, Postanska stedionica, Jugobanka; Serbian payment integrators) were not enumerated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add ARBK/KBRA business registry (Serbian interface), APR (Serbia), and bank investor/press pages as indirect sources; use them to attribute award notices to real corporate entities.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival strategy was identified for Serbian-language Kosovo sources, which are unusually volatile (outlets close, municipal sites are restructured, notices are removed after award periods).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair every source in this cell with Wayback/archive.today snapshotting at collection time so award notices remain citable after removal.

coverage_gaps.description: Cyrillic-script querying was under-used: most searches ran in Serbian Latin, while Serbia-side institutional sources (NBS, kim.gov.rs, DRI) publish heavily in Cyrillic.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-run the seed and glossary queries in Cyrillic (jавне набавке, обавештење о додели уговора, банкарске услуге, платни промет) and treat Latin/Cyrillic as two distinct retrieval channels.

coverage_gaps.description: No register specifically enumerating licensed payment institutions / e-money institutions was isolated; they appear folded into the BQK 'institucione financiare jobankare (IFJB)' category without a payments-specific view.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Parse the BQK licensed-institutions PDF by category and extract the IFJB block; check BQK licensing subpages for a payments/e-money licence type page.

coverage_gaps.description: Serbian-language (sr) pointer coverage is thin; only one chamber source found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run targeted sr queries against Kosovo domains (e.g. 'licencirane banke Kosovo', 'javne nabavke Kosovo lista ugovornih organa', 'registar preduzeca Kosovo') and check whether rks-gov.net portals publish sr-language versions.

coverage_gaps.description: No Kosovo register of registered/qualified economic operators or debarred suppliers was located (the sq query resolved to Albania).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Query KRPP directly with Kosovo-pinned terms and inspect krpp.rks-gov.net sections; if none exists, derive the supplier universe from award notices plus ARBK activity codes.

coverage_gaps.description: Public enterprises (ndërmarrjet publike) and municipalities as contracting authorities were not separately enumerated in this pass, although many are banking/payments-relevant buyers (utility billing, POS collection).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extract the public-enterprise list from the Ministry/Public Enterprises unit and the 38 municipalities from kk.rks-gov.net, then join to the KRPP contracting-authority list.

coverage_gaps.description: ARBK's official search is an ASP.NET form-driven site and bulk collection viability is unverified; reliance on third-party mirrors introduces freshness risk.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test the official ARBK search programmatically and benchmark a sample of records against arbk.org and the applifyer API to quantify staleness before choosing a primary path.

coverage_gaps.description: Only three of the nine KBA member banks (Raiffeisen, ProCredit, BPB) have an identified careers/news endpoint; TEB, NLB Prishtina, BKT, Banka Ekonomike, Credins, IsBank and Ziraat are not yet mapped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Systematically resolve the sq careers ('Karriera' / 'Vende të lira pune') and news paths for each remaining KBA member bank and register each as its own source.

coverage_gaps.description: Non-bank PSPs, e-money and payment institutions licensed by BQK (and card processors/switch operators serving Kosovo) were not enumerated in this pass; only Paysera Kosova appeared incidentally.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pull the BQK register of licensed payment/e-money institutions and build careers/LinkedIn/event monitors for each entity.

coverage_gaps.description: LinkedIn — the single richest indirect channel for this cell (company announcements, role titles, employee moves) — is ToS/login restricted and cannot be scraped.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Decide between licensed data access and a manual analyst watchlist of ~25 Kosovo bank/PSP/integrator company pages plus key role titles; do not build a scraper.

coverage_gaps.description: Kosovo job adverts are removed shortly after the application deadline, so hiring signals are lost unless captured within days.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run daily crawls with full-text snapshotting on kosovajob.com, duapune.com, punaime.org and portalpune.com rather than periodic sampling.

coverage_gaps.description: Vendor/sponsor rosters of regional events that Kosovo banks attend (Balkan Payment Forum, KosICT, Balkan Fintech Association activities, ICT chamber events) are only partially mapped, and past-edition agendas were not retrieved.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Archive agenda/speaker/sponsor pages for the last three editions of each event and build a recurring pre-event capture job.

coverage_gaps.description: No working access to web-archive infrastructure in this session: web.archive.org was blocked at the tool level, and no alternative archive service (archive.today, Common Crawl, Bing/Google cache, national web archive) was tested as a substitute.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Route web-archive retrieval through a channel not subject to the fetch restriction — a direct HTTP client in the collection pipeline hitting the Wayback CDX and Availability APIs, plus archive.today and Common Crawl index lookups. Then build a capture inventory for e-prokurimi.rks-gov.net, oshp.rks-gov.net, arkivaoshp.rks-gov.net and aqp.rks-gov.net.

coverage_gaps.description: Pre-2016 procurement history is thin. The official OCDS feed starts in March 2016; prokurimihapur.org claims coverage from 2010 but self-reports that only 14.57 percent of extracted contracts passed quality filtering and that automated gathering began only in 2018.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Reconstruct 2008–2016 primarily from the KRPP annual report PDF series (a 2013 edition is confirmed to exist) and the Balkan Tender Watch mirrors (2015, 2017 confirmed), accepting aggregate rather than notice-level granularity for that period, and document the break in series explicitly wherever a trend chart crosses 2016.

coverage_gaps.description: Serbian-language coverage of the archival layer is demonstrated only for institutional and legal documents (D+ analysis, ZKA /sr/ publications, legacy Assembly legislation). No Serbian-language notice archive, contract register, or PPRC annual report edition was found.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated Serbian-language pass targeting Serb-majority municipalities (Severna Mitrovica, Zvečan, Zubin Potok, Leposavić, Gračanica, Štrpce) on kk.rks-gov.net and any local domains, using terms javne nabavke, obaveštenje o dodeli ugovora, ugovor, okvirni sporazum, arhiva, and check whether e-prokurimi serves an /sr/ document tree parallel to /shq/ and /eng/.

coverage_gaps.description: Framework-agreement expiry data — the highest-value predictive signal in this cell — has an identified register (AQP centralized contracts) and an identified legal basis (one to three years, plus/minus 30 percent tolerance, automatic termination on exhaustion) but no confirmed structured field-level extraction path. Consumption against the indicative value, which determines actual early termination, is not published anywhere located.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test whether the OCDS Tender/Award objects carry framework-agreement flags and contractPeriod end dates; if they do, derive expiries at scale from the API. Where they do not, parse AQP contract PDFs for duration clauses, and treat call-off consumption as an access-to-information request target using the MAPL contract-management manual to specify the records sought.

coverage_gaps.description: Sector targeting is unsolved for the archival layer. No banking/payments-specific view of Kosovo procurement history exists, and it was not established whether the OCDS releases carry CPV codes or another classification usable to isolate ATM, POS, card, cash-handling and core-banking procurements.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe a sample of OCDS releases for classification fields; if CPV is present, build the sector filter on it, otherwise construct a bilingual keyword classifier over tender titles and descriptions (bankomat, ATM, terminal, POS, kartela/kartica, para të gatshme/gotovina, softuer bankar) and validate it against a hand-labelled sample.

coverage_gaps.description: Publicly owned enterprises and the Central Bank were not covered as archival publishers in this pass. Kosovo POEs (energy, telecom, water, post) and BQK are significant buyers of payment-adjacent technology and are frequently criticised for weak procurement planning, but their own document archives were not located.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate Kosovo POEs and BQK, locate each entity's procurement or documents section, and probe for the /arkiva/ legacy-subtree pattern observed at aip.rks-gov.net. Cross-check each against the KRPP OCDS Parties endpoint to confirm their canonical names for partyName queries.

coverage_gaps.description: Several priority sources in this cell are JavaScript-rendered or PDF-binary and defeated the plain fetch-to-markdown approach: krpp.rks-gov.net returned only a title, and the PPRC 2022 report returned an unparsed 2.2 MB PDF.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Provision the collection pipeline with a headless browser for JS-rendered portals (KRPP, OSHP MVC forms) and a real PDF text and table extractor with Albanian OCR fallback for scanned documents, before attempting systematic harvesting.

coverage_gaps.description: Removed-content detection is not yet instrumented. Nothing in the sources found reveals when KRPP or a contracting authority silently deletes or edits a historical notice, and the archival value of this cell depends on catching exactly those events.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Establish an immutable snapshot regime from the first collection run: hash every OCDS release and every harvested PDF, re-sweep on a fixed cadence, and diff against prior snapshots to produce a deletion and amendment log. Use the independent OCP mirror as the second opinion against the live KRPP API.

coverage_gaps.description: No authoritative list of Kosovo contracting authorities with their web domains was assembled — municipality slugs for kk.rks-gov.net, which authorities use own subdomains (gjakova.rks-gov.net style), and which have no site at all are all unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Obtain the official register of contracting authorities (KRPP/AQP publish one) and join it against a domain-discovery pass; that register converts this cell from ad-hoc search into systematic enumeration.

coverage_gaps.description: Serbian-language Kosovo municipal sources (North Mitrovica, Zvečan, Zubin Potok, Leposavić and other Serb-majority municipalities) are entirely uncovered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-run sr queries with municipality names spelled in Serbian plus a site: restriction to rks-gov.net, and check whether kk.rks-gov.net serves an /sr/ or ?lang=sr variant per municipality.

coverage_gaps.description: Every candidate in this slice is marked access-unverified; only one live fetch was attempted and it failed on DNS. Liveness, robots.txt posture and bot-defence behaviour are unknown across the whole cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run the deterministic liveness pass from an EU egress, capture robots.txt and HTTP status per domain, and re-classify anything returning 403 as bot-defended-but-live rather than dead.

coverage_gaps.description: Bid-opening minutes, tender dossiers and signed contract PDFs — the detail this cell exists to capture, over and above the central portal — were only confirmed at msh.rks-gov.net and bqk-kos.org. Whether municipalities publish that depth is untested.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Once kk.rks-gov.net is reachable, sample 5 municipalities and inventory which document types each publishes; use that to score whether municipal crawling is worth the ongoing cost.

coverage_gaps.description: Health-sector buyers below the ministry (SHSKUK, regional hospitals, QKUK) and the pension/social-transfer payment side of MFPT were not reached, despite being among the largest disbursement operations in the country.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Targeted pass on SHSKUK and on MFPT's social-transfer/pension payment units, searching sq terms 'pagesa e pensioneve', 'transferet sociale', 'shërbime bankare për pagesa'.

coverage_gaps.description: The exact machine-readable endpoints for the World Bank procurement notice search and for ECEPP's country/sector-filtered notice search were not established in this pass; only the human-facing URLs were identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a technical reconnaissance pass on projects.worldbank.org/procurement and ecepp.ebrd.com to capture the underlying JSON/XHR endpoints, pagination and rate limits before building collectors.

coverage_gaps.description: Several plausible donor actors in this cell were not searched or not resolved: Council of Europe Development Bank (CEB), Swiss SECO/SDC, Austrian ADA, Italian AICS, Luxembourg cooperation, IFAD, and the World Bank Group's Western Balkans regional digital/payments programmes; also the EU's Western Balkans Investment Framework (WBIF) and Growth Plan / Reform and Growth Facility procurement.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend discovery to WBIF (wbif.eu), CEB, SECO and the EU Growth Plan for the Western Balkans, all of which fund financial-infrastructure and public-finance work and publish their own calls.

coverage_gaps.description: Albanian coverage is solid (njoftim për kontratë, njoftim për dhënie të kontratës, njoftim specifik për prokurim, ftesë për ofertë, prokurim, tenderët) but Serbian-language terminology for donor procurement in Kosovo remains largely untested against real notice text.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Test Serbian terms (javni poziv za dostavljanje ponuda, obaveštenje o nabavci, poziv za iskazivanje interesa, obaveštenje o dodeli ugovora) against Kosovo-Serb municipal and UN/OSCE channels to confirm whether any donor notice surface exists in Serbian.

coverage_gaps.description: Donor notices are short-lived: MFK, GIZ and BQK drop PDFs that are later rotated off, and UNDB's shutdown removes a historical archive.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snapshot every discovered notice PDF/HTML at collection time into a local content-addressed store, and backfill historical UNDB and dgMarket Kosovo notices from web archives before they degrade further.

coverage_gaps.description: No mapping yet exists between donor project ids (P507881, MCC compact, EBRD operation numbers) and the implementing entities and winning suppliers that appear in Kosovo notices, so awards cannot yet be rolled up by programme or by vendor.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a small actor map keyed on BQK, DIFK/FSDK, KCGF/Fondi Kosovar për Garanci Kreditore, MFK/MCA-Kosovo, and known procurement agents (Crown Agents), with alias and transliteration variants, and use it as the join key across all donor feeds.

coverage_gaps.description: TED and the EU Funding & Tenders Portal are JavaScript-heavy single-page applications; naive HTML fetching will not yield notice content.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Implement collection against the TED Search API and eForms bulk packages, and against the F&T Portal's underlying JSON search service, rather than page scraping.

coverage_gaps.description: Award notices name consortium leaders, not the sub-contractors who actually deliver payment-system or card-personalisation components.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair TED award data with lot-holder/consortium disclosures (FWC SEA 2023 lot pages, corporate project pages) and with beneficiary-side publications (BQK, Ministry of Finance) to reconstruct the real delivery chain.

coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a vendor-side workstream: monitor supplier press rooms, reference/case-study pages, LinkedIn posts of Kosovo integrators, and CBK/bank annual reports for outsourcing disclosures, then join those to the RFP feed by subject and date.
